an5.216:1.3: Bahuno janassa appiyo hoti amanāpo, luddho ca hoti, vippaṭisārī ca, sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
an5.216:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā akkhantiyā. 3.
an5.216:2.3: Bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo, aluddho ca hoti, avippaṭisārī ca, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.216:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā khantiyā
